usedFor: Formidable Forms collects form entries, and “New Form Submission” starts work the moment one is sent.

bestTemplate.name: “New Form Submission” in Formidable Forms, then “Update Multiple Rows” in Google Sheets
bestTemplate.why: Each submission is logged as rows in a sheet, so answers sit in one place.

watchOut: AI agents run on a schedule or when asked, so a submission waits for the next run.
